'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

environmentVariables.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. environmentVariables.description: A priced judge model; answers_the_ask then asks it on every evaluation with input, sending that input and output to the model's provider, and gates on its verdict (off by default)

environmentVariables.description: The name of IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_DAILY_BUDGET_USD before 0.21.0. Read when the new name is unset, and it then limits every judge call

environmentVariables.description: Relevance judge calls one request may make (default 20)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_MAX_CALLS_PER_REQUEST

environmentVariables.description: on (default) replaces the PII and credentials no_pii flags before the relevance judge sends input and output to its provider; off sends them as they are
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_RELEVANCE_JUDGE_REDACT

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DASHBOARD_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The most one verify_citations call may spend on judge calls, in USD (default 1); max_cost_usd_total can lower it, never raise it
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CITATION_MAX_COST_USD_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http; same as --transport
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1); only used with --transport http
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for the HTTP transport and dashboard CORS (default http://localhost:*)
environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: The most array elements and object keys one input may hold before it is validated (default 100000): a tool call's arguments, and a dashboard or OTLP JSON request body. A tool call over it gets an error result; a body, 413. OTLP protobuf has its own ceiling, one element per 5 bytes of the request size limit

capabilities: Play, pause, skip and queue tracks in the Music app

Create playlists and add tracks, including tracks you do not own yet

Export your library and take snapshots of it

distribution.note: The primary channel is a notarized macOS app: download, drag to Applications, double-click. The first-run window installs the background helper and writes the MCP client config. The PyPI package in `packages` is the same server for people who prefer a terminal install; it bundles the same signed MusicKit helper, so it is not a reduced build.

privacy.credentials: None stored. Apple's MusicKit signs each request from the app's own code-signing identity plus a one-time consent prompt.
privacy.network: Apple's public catalog endpoints and Apple Music's own API. No third-party service, no telemetry.
privacy.permissions: Automation access to the Music app, and Apple Music access. No Accessibility, no browser automation, no synthetic clicks.

requirements.account: No Apple Developer account, no API key, and no token are required.
requirements.arch: Apple Silicon or Intel (both are published)
requirements.needs: The Music app, signed into Apple Music. A subscription is required for catalog playback and adds.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: One complete MCP product case is free. Start market_access_check with a plain-language message and no case_id. Then follow the returned state and next_action, carrying the opaque case_id unchanged. Answer clarification questions by their stable keys. Stage 2 runs after seller confirmation or an active case-scoped delegation. Browser actions declare delegated_execution: an agent with the listed authority and required capability may complete them; otherwise give the URL to the seller. Payment needs a separate mandate covering the displayed amount, currency and terms. Never infer permission. A new product or SKU requires paid API access. describe_coverage and watch_product_regulatory_changes stay open.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.safetyBoundary: Market-access readiness only. Not legal advice, certification, product approval, or marketplace approval guarantee.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Databricks: personal access token (simplest auth option). Either this or DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID + DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET is required to use the databricks engine.
environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client ID (preferred for automated use). Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET as well.
environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client secret. Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID as well.
environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept text containing more than one SQL statement. Off by default: the cost cap is only known to cover the single statement the dry run/EXPLAIN priced. Skips only this server's scanner: Snowflake still rejects multi-statement text (sessions are pinned to MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT=1), and only a single SELECT/WITH/VALUES statement is wrapped in a LIMIT subquery - a script runs unwrapped and its row cap (max_rows, default 1000) is enforced by the paged fetch.
environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 (exactly that value) to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept statements that are not reads. Off by default: only text whose first keyword (after comments and opening parentheses) is SELECT, WITH, VALUES, SHOW, DESCRIBE, DESC or EXPLAIN is estimated or run - a WITH must be followed by a SELECT or VALUES - because warehouse rows re-enter the model's context and can steer the next call. The gate is defence in depth: the authorisation boundary is the credential's grants (deploy a read-only principal). With COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL=1 every statement in the text must be a read, so BigQuery scripts (DECLARE/SET/BEGIN) need both opt-outs. Any other value leaves the gate on.
environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_WRITE_STATEMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of run_query_bounded calls allowed in flight at once (positive integer, default 8). A cancelled call keeps its slot until its warehouse query completes or the 120 s watchdog fires; a call over the cap fails with a tool error naming this variable before any warehouse connection is opened.
environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_QUERIES

environmentVariables.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Databricks tools (check_credentials, estimate_query_cost) open a session on a SQL warehouse that is not RUNNING, which starts the warehouse and bills compute until it auto-stops. Off by default: the server first reads the warehouse's state through the Warehouses API (GET /api/2.0/sql/warehouses/<id>, CAN_VIEW/CAN_USE suffices) and, unless it is RUNNING - also when the state cannot be read - check_credentials returns ok=false and estimate_query_cost returns no byte or dollar figure, without opening a session. run_query_bounded is not gated: its own pre-execution estimate and the execution may start the warehouse. Any other value leaves the guard on.
environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_DATABRICKS_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_START

environmentVariables.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Snowflake tools run SELECT CURRENT_REGION(), the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY read and check_credentials' session-context SELECT on a warehouse that is not STARTED, which can resume a suspended AUTO_RESUME warehouse and bill compute until it auto-suspends. Off by default: those statements are skipped unless the pinned warehouse's SHOW WAREHOUSES state is STARTED (also skipped when no warehouse is pinned or the state cannot be read), and the QUERY_HISTORY read is skipped whenever estimate_query_cost is called without a warehouse argument; estimate_query_cost then prices at Gen1 rates with the byte-tier heuristic and says so in a caveat, and check_credentials returns ok=true with a detail built from the SHOW WAREHOUSES row. USE WAREHOUSE, EXPLAIN USING JSON, SHOW WAREHOUSES and SELECT CURRENT_WAREHOUSE() always run; run_query_bounded is not gated. Any other value leaves the guard on.
environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_SNOWFLAKE_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_RESUME

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_CODES

environmentVariables.description: Register apple_safari_network_record, _list and _get, which record what a page you allowed the extension on fetches and read the responses. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read; off means the tools do not exist. Headers named like credentials are masked, bodies are not. Reloading a tab to record and saving a body to a file still need APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES.
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Register apple_safari_cookies, which lists the cookies Safari would send to an open page, HttpOnly ones included, through the extension's cookies permission. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read; off means the tool does not exist. Not enough on its own: only sites in APPLE_SAFARI_COOKIE_HOSTS are readable. Values never come back inline; saveAs writes named ones to a 0600 file and needs APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES.
environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_COOKIES

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated registrable domains whose cookies apple_safari_cookies may read, like "yahoo.com"; each covers the domain and its subdomains. Empty, the default, means no site is readable. An entry with no dot is ignored.

environmentVariables.description: Where saveAs writes a file, for apple_safari_network_get and apple_safari_cookies. Defaults to ~/Downloads. A name is kept to its basename and an existing file is never replaced unless asked.

environmentVariables.description: Characters of a body the server asks the page for per command when it reads a large body. Defaults to 262144, which was measured to work; how far above that Safari's native-message channel goes is unmeasured.

server.name: io.github.midhunxavier/opcua
server.description: Connect AI assistants to industrial OPC UA: browse, read, history, subscriptions, events and alarms.
server.title: OPC UA MCP Server

environmentVariables.description: URL of the OPC UA server to connect to, including any path the server expects. Read once at startup: one process serves one endpoint. Verify who answers with an exact server certificate pin or a configured CA trust store.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Select the Python client implementation. The maintained asyncua client is the default; legacy provides the one-release rollback path for uncovered vendor incompatibilities. This setting affects the Python server only.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PYTHON_BACKEND

environmentVariables.description: Encryption suite to negotiate for the secure channel. Anything other than None needs a client certificate and key. The two AES suites are Node-only: the Python runtime refuses them at startup rather than downgrading. None is unencrypted and unauthenticated, and keeps control tools blocked unless insecure control is explicitly allowed. An unknown policy stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_POLICY

environmentVariables.description: Message security mode for the secure channel. Sign authenticates messages without encrypting them. A policy with mode None, or a mode without a policy, stops the server at startup; leaving it blank never downgrades a policy to signing only. Leave blank for SignAndEncrypt once a security policy is set, otherwise None.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SECURITY_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the certificate (PEM or DER) this client presents as its application identity. Required by any security policy other than None. A path that does not exist stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_CERT

environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key matching the client certificate. A path, never key material. Whoever can read the file can impersonate this client: keep it readable only by the account running the server. A path that does not exist stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_CLIENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Application URI announced to the server. Set it only for a certificate that carries no URI of its own. A configured URI that conflicts with the certificate is refused before connecting. Leave blank for the subjectAltName URI of the client certificate.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_APPLICATION_URI

environmentVariables.description: Path to the OPC UA server's own certificate (PEM or DER), pinned: a server presenting any other certificate cannot complete the handshake. Control tools (writes, method calls, alarm actions) require it, or OPCUA_SERVER_TRUST_STORE instead. Requires a security policy other than None. Unset, encryption protects against eavesdropping but not against an impostor endpoint, so control tools are refused unless OPCUA_SERVER_TRUST_STORE validates the server or OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL is set. Set without a security policy, it stops the server at startup rather than pinning nothing; a pinned certificate that has expired or is not yet valid refuses to connect.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_CERT

environmentVariables.description: Directory with trusted/certs root CAs, issuers/certs intermediate CAs, and trusted/crl plus issuers/crl signed current revocation lists. Authenticate the OPC UA peer by its validated chain and expected server URI. Requires secured channel and OPCUA_SERVER_APPLICATION_URI; Python requires the maintained asyncua backend. Missing, stale, forged or revoked trust material refuses connection. Cannot be combined with an exact server certificate pin.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_TRUST_STORE

environmentVariables.description: ApplicationUri of the intended OPC UA server. Must match the peer certificate URI SAN and advertised application identity. Required with OPCUA_SERVER_TRUST_STORE.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SERVER_APPLICATION_URI

environmentVariables.description: OPC UA username. The session is anonymous when unset. Cannot be combined with a user certificate. Requires a password; either one alone stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Password for the username. Without a security policy it crosses the network in clear text. Supply it through the client's secret storage, never on a command line.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Path to the certificate identifying the user, for X.509 user authentication: a different key pair from the client certificate, which secures the channel. Requires the user key and a security policy other than None; cannot be combined with a username. Any of those combinations broken stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USER_CERT

environmentVariables.description: Path to the private key for the user certificate. It signs the server's challenge and is never sent. Whoever can read the file can log in as this user: keep it readable only by the account running the server.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_USER_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Which tools are offered. observe reads, browses, reads history and monitors; operator adds explicitly allowlisted writes, method calls and alarm actions; full exposes every tool and is meant only for a tightly scoped OPC UA account. Unset fails closed to observe; an unknown profile stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_PROFILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a version-1 JSON policy file, the only place per-node value bounds, writable_subtrees, preconditions, the alarm scope and deny_read can be set. Every policy variable that is set overrides what the file says. An unreadable or invalid file stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_POLICY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool allowlist. It can only narrow the selected profile, never widen it. An unknown tool name stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact node IDs the operator profile may write, as ns=2;i=5 or, stable across a server restart, nsu=<namespace-uri>;i=5 or a browse path from the Root folder such as /Objects/Line1/Setpoint. Setting it replaces the policy file's list, bounds included. Empty fails closed: operator can write nothing. A batch write with any target outside the list is refused before it reaches OPC UA.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_WRITE_NODES

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated object_node_id|method_node_id pairs the operator profile may call. Either half may be a browse path from the Root folder. Empty fails closed: operator can call nothing. An entry without | stops the server at startup.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOWED_METHODS

environmentVariables.description: Let the operator profile act on alarms: acknowledge_alarm and every act_on_alarm action.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_ACKNOWLEDGE_ALARMS

environmentVariables.description: Permit control tools on an OPC UA channel with no security policy (None). Does not cover a secured channel to an unverified server; that is OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL. Fail-open override: writes, method calls and alarm actions then travel unauthenticated and unencrypted. Reported as control=INSECURE-OVERRIDE in the startup line, get_server_status and every audit record. Never enable it against production equipment.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL

environmentVariables.description: Permit control tools on a secured OPC UA channel whose server is not authenticated: neither pinned with OPCUA_SERVER_CERT nor validated by OPCUA_SERVER_TRUST_STORE. Does not cover a channel with no security policy; that is OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE_CONTROL. Fail-open override: writes, method calls and alarm actions are then encrypted to whichever server answered the endpoint, which may be an impostor. Reported as control=UNVERIFIED-OVERRIDE in the startup line, get_server_status and every audit record. Never enable it against production equipment.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_SERVER_CONTROL

environmentVariables.description: Allow a write outside the EURange the OPC UA server itself published for the node. A published InstrumentRange still applies. Fail-open override: it discards the only value bound a deployment with no policy file has.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_ALLOW_OUT_OF_RANGE_WRITES

environmentVariables.description: Path to an append-only file for the control audit trail, one JSON object per line, written beside stderr. Created owner-only (0600) if it does not exist; reopened when rotated away. A file that cannot be opened, or that is a symlink, not a regular file, another account's, or group/world-writable, stops the server rather than falling back to stderr alone. While set, a control call whose record cannot be written is refused (fail closed); reads continue.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUDIT_FILE

environmentVariables.description: When an audit-file record counts as written. always fsyncs each record before the control call proceeds, so it survives a power loss; none leaves it to the operating system, so it survives only a crash of this process. none can lose the records of control calls that already reached the plant if the machine loses power.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUDIT_FSYNC

environmentVariables.description: Adds seq, prev_hash and hash to every audit record so edits, deletions and reordering can be detected with --verify-audit. sha256 catches accidental or naive edits; hmac-sha256 also resists anyone without the key. Requires the audit file. Set without an audit file, or hmac-sha256 without a key file, stops the server. No chain detects a truncated tail.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUDIT_CHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Path to the HMAC key for the hmac-sha256 audit chain: at least 32 bytes, for example from openssl rand -hex 32. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Whoever can read the key can forge the chain: a key readable or writable by group or others stops the server. Refused unless the chain is hmac-sha256.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Label stamped on every audit record as operator_label, so a shipped log says which deployment a control call came from. Configured, never verified: it is not an identity, and mcp_principal stays null.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_OPERATOR_ID

environmentVariables.description: Wait before the first attempt to repair a dropped or refused connection, in milliseconds. It doubles with each further attempt.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_INITIAL_DELAY_MS

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for the doubling retry delay, in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries after the first attempt, per connection round, before a tool call gives up: a whole number from -1 to 1000. 0 never retries; -1 never stops trying, in bounded rounds of four retries so no single call waits forever.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_RECONNECT_MAX_RETRY

environmentVariables.description: Session lifetime asked of the OPC UA server, in milliseconds. It also sets the keep-alive period, so it decides how quickly an idle connection notices the server has gone.
environmentVariables.name: OPCUA_SESSION_TIMEOUT_MS

packageArguments.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation. Deprecated: the MCP protocol is moving to sessionless, so this option will soon be removed and the connection scope will default to 'global'. For shared-server use cases, use the Atlas-Managed MCP server or build an authenticated library using the @mongodb-js/mcp-cli package. Note: on the sessionless (2026-07-28) HTTP path, a request without an mcp-session-id falls back to the shared ('global') scope so it can still persist connections across requests; the legacy sessionful path always carries a server-issued session.
packageArguments.name: --connectionScope

packageArguments.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections, exposed under the connectionId "preconfigured". packageArguments.description: When set to true, allows binding the HTTP server (and monitoring server) to a non-loopback host such as 0.0.0.0, a LAN IP, or an empty host (all interfaces). environmentVariables.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation. Deprecated: the MCP protocol is moving to sessionless, so this option will soon be removed and the connection scope will default to 'global'. For shared-server use cases, use the Atlas-Managed MCP server or build an authenticated library using the @mongodb-js/mcp-cli package. Note: on the sessionless (2026-07-28) HTTP path, a request without an mcp-session-id falls back to the shared ('global') scope so it can still persist connections across requests; the legacy sessionful path always carries a server-issued session.
environmentVariables.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: Path to the repo root that holds the .tickets-tracker store (defaults to the git toplevel of the working dir).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_ROOT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read tools (no write/mutation tools).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the billable LLM tools (review_code / scan_spec / verify_completion / review_plan); off by default.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM

environmentVariables.description: In-flight de-duplication of the long-running gate tools (review_plan / verify_completion): a concurrent duplicate call for the same ticket+basis attaches to the running gate instead of launching a second billable LLM pass. On by default; set to 0 to disable (kill-switch).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_DEDUP

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow bridge_sync to perform live (mutating) Jira sync; otherwise bridge_sync uses dry-run behavior.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_JIRA_SYNC

environmentVariables.description: Transport for the MCP server: 'stdio' (default) or 'http' (the optional Streamable-HTTP transport).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Bind host for the Streamable-HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Bind port for the Streamable-HTTP transport (1-65535; default 8000).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: URL path the Streamable-HTTP transport serves on (default /mcp).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact host:port values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact Origin values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge TLS is terminated at the edge; required to bind the Streamable-HTTP transport to a non-loopback host.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge running the Streamable-HTTP transport without a token verifier; required to boot the HTTP transport while auth is off.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable MCP authentication (the composite token verifier + Resource-Server wiring); off by default.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated, ordered list of token-verifier strategies to compose (closed set: static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES

environmentVariables.description: OAuth authorization-server issuer URL advertised in the Protected-Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) when auth is enabled.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL

environmentVariables.description: The single resource identifier (RFC 8707 audience) for this server; the composite verifier re-checks every accepted token against it.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated scopes a caller must hold; the SDK returns 403 insufficient_scope when a principal lacks one.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON secrets file for the static-bearer verifier (stores only SHA-256 digests of the accepted tokens).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS JWKS endpoint the `jwt` verifier fetches signing keys from (an OIDC provider's .well-known/jwks.json).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI

environmentVariables.description: Expected `iss` claim for the `jwt` verifier; falls back to REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL when unset.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated PINNED, asymmetric-only JWS algorithms for the `jwt` verifier (default RS256,ES256); a symmetric algorithm on a JWKS source is refused.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHMS

environmentVariables.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds applied to exp/nbf validation by the `jwt` verifier (default 60).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY

environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between JWKS refetches triggered by an unknown key id (the concurrency-safe flood guard; default 30).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN

environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the `jwt` verifier's JWKS fetch (default 10).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: When set, the `jwt` verifier requires the JWT header `typ` to equal this (e.g. at+JWT per RFC 9068); unset skips the check.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_EXPECTED_TYP

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback JWKS host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_JWKS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The `introspection` verifier's RFC 7662 endpoint URL (must be https://); the opaque token is POSTed here on every request (no caching).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: The client id the `introspection` verifier presents to the Authorization Server via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: The NAME of the env var holding the introspection client secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the server refuses to start (fail-closed).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback introspection endpoint host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to accept an active introspection response that OMITS `aud` (many AS do); off by default (fail-closed reject).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_MISSING_AUD

environmentVariables.description: The NAME of the env var holding the trusted-proxy shared secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the `proxy` verifier refuses to start (fail-closed).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_ENV

environmentVariables.description: The header the fronting proxy sends its shared secret on; the identity is trusted only when this matches (constant-time; default x-proxy-auth).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_HEADER

environmentVariables.description: The header carrying the proxy-authenticated principal identity, trusted only when the secret header validates (default x-forwarded-user).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_IDENTITY_HEADER

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated fixed scope set granted to proxy-authenticated principals; empty by default (the principal holds no scopes).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SCOPES

environmentVariables.description: The `custom` strategy's `module:factory` import string, resolving to a factory that returns a TokenVerifier; a TRUSTED operator config value that loads and executes the operator-configured code at startup (fail-closed on any load error).
environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT

server.name: io.github.partymola/ticktick-mcp
server.description: MCP server for TickTick task management: field-preserving updates and completion tracking.

uid_gid.description: Your own user and group id, as `uid:gid` (run `id -u`:`id -g`). The container runs as root otherwise, and anything it writes into the mounted directory becomes root-owned - after which a host-side `ticktick-mcp` can no longer update its session-token cache and falls back to a signon TickTick throttles.

data_volume.description: Absolute path to the host directory of an ALREADY AUTHORISED setup - it must already hold the cached OAuth token written by running `ticktick-mcp auth` in a terminal. Not an empty volume and not a relative path: the OAuth step cannot run inside the container, and a container without a cached token reads standard input, which is the JSON-RPC channel. Also holds the .env, the v2 session token and the completion-tracking database.

server.name: io.github.pete-builds/unifi
server.description: Safe-by-default UniFi MCP: Network + Protect + Access, multi-site, dry-run, audit log.
server.title: UniFi Gateway

environmentVariables.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true. Set to false to manage a real gateway, which then needs UNIFI_HOST plus UNIFI_API_KEY (or UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE), or MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE. In either mode the HTTP transport will not start without MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS.
environmentVariables.name: STUB_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Bearer tokens that HTTP clients must present. Required: the streamable-http transport exits at startup with 'HTTP transport requires MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS' when it is empty. Comma-separated; each entry is a bare token (named client-N automatically) or a 'name:token' pair. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUTH_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: When true, every tool that changes state is hidden from tools/list and refused on tools/call; read tools are unaffected. Defense in depth on top of a read-only UniFi API key. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset, unless UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE is used instead.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file inside the container that holds the local API key, for a Docker or Kubernetes secret mount. Wins over UNIFI_API_KEY when both are set. A controller configured this way verifies the gateway's TLS certificate unless UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL is set to false.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file inside the container that holds the gateway's own certificate in PEM, recorded with mcp-unifi-pin-cert. When set, that certificate is the only one the server accepts from the gateway, and a mismatch fails every request. Do not set UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL to false alongside it: the server refuses to start.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_PINNED_CERT

environmentVariables.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_SITE

environmentVariables.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL

environmentVariables.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access currently ships read-only; door unlocks and credential issuance require session-token auth and are deferred.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST

environmentVariables.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK

environmentVariables.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH

server.name: io.github.piprail/mcp
server.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.
server.title: PipRail

environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN

environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS

environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL

environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM

environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW

environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION

environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.
environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
